d:
Arabian Aces soared to a commanding 37-run victory over Emirates Eagles in the 17th match of the Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026!
The Aces delivered a strong all-round performance to outclass the Eagles and secure a crucial win in the tournament.
With this victory, Arabian Aces climbed to the second spot on the points table, strengthening their push in the competition!
Watch 2026 | 7th NOV to 20th NOV on Star Sports & JioHotstar.
